steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all required biological materials, reagents, solutions, and laboratory supplies with the following catalog numbers: C57BL/10 WT mouse (JAX #000665); Ethanol (Sigma #32221); PBS (Sigma #D8662); Protein inhibitor complex (PIC, Roche #11873580001); Ribolock (Thermo Fisher #EO0381); PMSF (Roche #10837091001); Dynabeads Protein G (Thermo Fisher #10004D); Tri‑reagent (Zymo #R2050-1-200); HEPES (Sigma #H3375); KCl (Sigma #P9541); EDTA (Sigma #EDS); NaF (Sigma #201154); NP40 (Sigma #I3021); Tween‑20 (Sigma #P9416); DTT (Roche #10708984001); Tris‑HCl (Sigma #T1503); NaCl (Sigma #S9888); SDS (PanReac #A3942); Proteinase K (Roche #3115828001); Laemmli sample buffer (Bio‑Rad #1610747); Anti‑MATR3 antibody (Bethyl #A300-591A, 1:500 WB, 5 µg IP); Anti‑IgG antibody (Immunoreagents #Rb-003-N, 5 µg); Direct‑zol RNA MiniPrep (Zymo #R2050); SuperScript VILO cDNA kit (Thermo Fisher #11754050); PowerUp SYBR‑Green MasterMix (Thermo Fisher #A25742); primers as listed; 1.5 mL tubes (Sarstedt #72.706); 15 mL tubes (Corning #430791); 100 mm tissue‑culture petri dish (Corning #353003); 70 µm cell strainer (Neonatal Heart Dissociation Kit).

steps.title: Prepare all solutions
steps.instruction: Make fresh on the day of the experiment the following solutions using the indicated final concentrations and volumes:

substeps.instruction: Dissociation media (1 mL for 10–12 E15.5 hearts): 0.983 mL PBS, 10 µL 0.1 M PMSF (1×), 10 µL Ribolock (40 U/µL, 1:300), 3.3 µL PIC tablet dissolved in 500 µL RNase/DNase‑free water (1×).

NP40 lysis buffer (store @ +4 °C, up to 6 months): For 50 mL, combine 2.5 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.5 (50 mM), 2.5 mL 1 M KCl (150 mM), 7.5 mL 0.5 M EDTA (2 mM), 200 µL 1 M NaF (1 mM), 50 µL 100 % NP40 (0.5 %), 39.5 mL H₂O. On the day of use add 0.5 mM DTT (1 M stock), 1× PIC, and Ribolock 1:200–1:400.
High‑Salt NP40 wash buffer (store @ +4 °C, up to 6 months): For 50 mL, mix 2.5 mL 1 M HEPES pH 7.5 (50 mM), 5 mL 5 M KCl (500 mM), 250 µL 10 % NP40 (0.05 %), 42.25 mL H₂O.

Proteinase K buffer (store at room temperature, up to 6 months): For 50 mL, combine 5 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (100 mM), 5 mL 1 M NaCl (150 mM), 7.5 mL 0.5 M EDTA (12.5 mM), 1.25 mL 20 % SDS (2 %), 31.25 mL H₂O. Add 0.5 mM DTT, 1× PIC and Ribolock 1:200–1:400 just before use.
PBT (PBS + 0.02 % Tween‑20) for bead washes: 0.02 % (v/v) Tween‑20 in PBS.
Supplemented NP40 lysis buffer for dilution: NP40 lysis buffer plus 1× PIC and Ribolock 1:200–1:400.

steps.title: Isolate embryonal hearts
steps.instruction: Euthanize a pregnant mouse by CO₂ or cervical dislocation, spray skin and fur with 70 % ethanol, place mouse under a hood, pinch skin with tweezers, incise abdomen, cut peritoneum, expose placenta, cut placenta to free embryos, transfer embryos to a PBS‑filled petri dish, cut off heads, open chest cavities and excise hearts (1–3 mm depending on stage), place each heart into a 1.5 mL tube containing 1 mL cold PBS (max 5–6 hearts per tube).

steps.title: Manually dissociate hearts
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL dissociation media (see step 2). Remove most PBS from the tube so hearts settle at the bottom, add 500 µL cold dissociation media, mash hearts with a pestle on ice for 2–4 min, then pipette up and down with a 1,000 µL tip until no visible clumps remain; optionally trap hearts between pestle and tube edge for faster dissociation.

steps.title: Filter cardiac cell suspension
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm cell strainer on a 15 mL tube kept on ice, slowly transfer the homogenate into the strainer with a P1000 pipette, allow gravity filtration, wash the strainer with PBS until the total collected volume reaches 5 mL, gently scrape the strainer top with a cell lifter (avoid tearing membrane), pour the 5 mL filtrate into a 100 mm petri dish at room temperature, inspect cells under a bright‑field microscope for viability (cells should remain in suspension).

steps.title: UV‑crosslink cells and freeze pellets
steps.instruction: Remove the petri‑dish lid and place the cells in a Spectrolinker UV crosslinker; irradiate at 254 nm with 4,000 µJ cm⁻² on ice. Harvest cells by passing the suspension through a cell strainer into a 15 mL tube, centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, gently discard supernatant, snap‑freeze the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (up to 12 months). For larger experiments repeat steps 3–5 to obtain sufficient material (≥1 mg total protein per condition).

steps.title: Prepare protein extract
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen pellets on ice, resuspend each pellet in 3 mL NP40 lysis buffer, pipette up/down with a P1000 until homogeneous, split the lysate into three 1.5 mL tubes (1 mL each), incubate 10 min at 4 °C with gentle shaking, sonicate on a Bioruptor Plus for six low‑intensity cycles (30 s each) at 4 °C, centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C and collect the clear supernatant (total cellular extract). If the supernatant remains turbid, repeat centrifugation and repeat the lysis with 1 mL NP40 lysis buffer instead of 3 mL. Measure protein concentration by Bradford assay and dilute the extract in supplemented NP40 lysis buffer to a final concentration of 1 mg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Load magnetic beads with antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL PBT containing 1× PIC and Ribolock 1:200–1:400 (sufficient for two 2‑h incubations). Label two 1.5 mL tubes ‘IP’ and ‘IgG’. Vortex Dynabeads Protein G magnetic particles, add 30 µL beads to each tube, wash each tube with 1 mL PBT, place on magnetic rack, discard supernatant, repeat wash once more, aspirate the final wash without touching beads, remove tubes from the rack and resuspend beads in 400 µL PBT. Add 5–10 µg anti‑MATR3 antibody to the IP tube and 5–10 µg IgG control antibody to the IgG tube (use same isotype for both), incubate 2 h at room temperature on a rotating wheel.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate target complexes
steps.instruction: Wash the antibody‑bound beads twice with 1 mL PBT at room temperature (magnetic separation each wash). Keep 10 % of the prepared extract as INPUT on ice. Mix 1 mL (1 mg) of the extract with the IP beads and 1 mL of extract with the IgG beads, incubate overnight (~16 h) at 4 °C on a rotating wheel. The next day, wash beads three times with 1 mL High‑Salt NP40 wash buffer, then resuspend each bead pellet in 100 µL NP40 lysis buffer. Adjust the INPUT sample to 100 µL with NP40 lysis buffer. For each of the three samples (IP, IgG, INPUT) split the 100 µL into two tubes: 75 µL for RNA processing and 25 µL for protein processing (3:1 v/v ratio).

steps.title: Extract RNA from beads
steps.instruction: To the 75 µL bead suspension, add 125 µL Proteinase K buffer and 50 µL Proteinase K enzyme (final volume 250 µL), incubate 30 min at 50 °C with gentle shaking, spin briefly, add 3–5 volumes of Tri‑reagent, vortex, let beads settle on a magnetic rack, transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube; repeat the Tri‑reagent extraction twice more (total three extractions) ensuring no bead residue remains. Purify total RNA using the Direct‑zol RNA MiniPrep kit (or an equivalent phenol‑chloroform method). Expected yield ≈1 µg RNA in 30 µL RNase/DNase‑free H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare protein sample
steps.instruction: To the 25 µL bead suspension, add 10 µL 4× Laemmli sample buffer and 4 µL 50 mM DTT (from 0.5 M stock) to reach ~40 µL total, heat at 95 °C for 5 min, place on a magnetic rack, transfer the supernatant to a new tube and store at –80 °C until SDS‑PAGE and western blotting.

steps.title: Western blot of immunoprecipitates
steps.instruction: Load 20 µL (half) of each sample (INPUT, IP, IgG) onto an SDS‑PAGE gel, perform electrophoresis, transfer proteins to a membrane, and probe with anti‑MATR3 antibody (and GAPDH as loading control) to assess IP efficiency.

steps.title: Reverse transcription and qPCR
steps.instruction: Reverse‑transcribe the purified RNA using the SuperScript VILO cDNA Synthesis kit. Set up RT‑qPCR with PowerUp SYBR‑Green MasterMix using the listed primers (pCharme, mCharme, Gapdh). Cycling conditions: 2 min at 50 °C, 2 min at 95 °C; 40 cycles of 3 s at 95 °C and 30 s at 60 °C; melt curve: 15 s at 95 °C, 1 min at 60 °C, 30 s at 95 °C, 15 s at 60 °C. Analyze enrichment of pCharme relative to mCharme and Gapdh; optionally submit cDNA libraries for Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing.
